description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Why: ancora-xla squash-merged to main as f977c9a (release 1.1.0) while this epic branch (ancora-gg8/field-friction, tip 6e0f24e) carried seven merged children from base 7511407. Both rewrote the gate and parsing path. A dry-run merge conflicts in 21 files (six specs, docs/migration.md, gate.ex, compare.ex, index.ex, append_only.ex, config.ex, decision_parser/affects.ex, next.ex, output.ex, status.ex, and five test files). ancora-gg8.7 must build on 1.1.0, so this reconciliation runs first as its own ticket with cold verification. Manuel chose this sequence (option 1, 2026-09-04).

Deliverable:
1. In the stage worktree, merge origin/main (f977c9a) into the stage branch as ONE merge commit whose message references ancora-gg8.8 and lists, per conflicted file, how the two sides were combined. No rebase, no squash, no history rewrite of either side.
2. Resolution rule: both sides survive. Where main and this branch changed the same function, the result implements both behaviors (main: narrowed base-tree materialization, parse-once via plain arguments, ETS memo removed, NUL-delimited change sets with OID-resolved prefetch, env-tier failures, CLI/JSON contract fixes; this branch: governed missing_decision, requirement-scoped overrides, SourceScan, drift primary/transitive split with visible acks and --explain-acks, tags/tag_borrowed and append/statement_changed, lib_paths normalization, derivation de-dupe). Never resolve a conflict by taking one side wholesale unless the other side made no semantic change there; say so in the commit message when you do.
3. Specs: every requirement, scenario, and decisions: link from both sides is kept; registry enumerations and counts in docs/migration.md, priv/spec_init/agents/SKILL.md.eex and .spec/README.md reflect the union of both sides.
4. Tests: every test from both sides is kept and passes; no test deleted, renamed away, skipped, or loosened. If a test from one side asserts on output the other side changed by contract (for example the registry count or a rendered line), update the expected value to the union and state which side moved it.
5. If the merge needs small follow-up code edits beyond conflict hunks to compile or pass (a renamed argument, a moved helper), make them in the merge commit and name them in its message. Anything larger is a WORKER_ERROR for the orchestrator to rule on, not a design decision for this ticket.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: full mix test (both sides union), mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused, golden subprocess tests byte-stable.
- Spec gate: mix spec.check --base f977c9a must pass. Findings that the epic branch already acknowledged with committed Spec-Ack trailers stay in range and need no new trailer. Any new red is a WORKER_ERROR quoting the finding; do not add trailers or edit config to clear it.
- Proof in the IMPLEMENTED record: per-side test-name counts and the merged count (union, not max); per-spec requirement-id counts per side and merged; the list of conflicted files with one line each on the resolution; full-suite result line; spec.check result line.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix compile plus targeted files touched by the conflict; mix spec.validate.
  - Final tier: before IMPLEMENTED, full mix test plus mix spec.check --base f977c9a, run-until-green, 2-run cap.
  - Verifier tier: cold. Confirm the union properties by counting against both parents; run targeted tests plus mix spec.check --base f977c9a; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - No test or spec statement from either parent is missing in the merge result
  - Each conflicted production file implements both parents behaviors, traced to a passing test from each side
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface

Allowed touches (this stage may modify): only files that git reports as conflicted in the merge, plus test/** and the three registry-enumeration files (docs/migration.md, priv/spec_init/agents/SKILL.md.eex, .spec/README.md) when their counts need the union. Nothing else.

Out of Scope (intent): no new behavior, no perf work (that is ancora-gg8.7), no dropping either side, no Spec-Ack trailers or config demotions without an orchestrator ruling, no rebase.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Full suite passes
- [ ] mix spec.check --base f977c9a passes
- [ ] Scope check: diff vs both parents touches only conflicted files, tests, and the registry-enumeration files
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: Reconcile field-friction with release 1.1.0: merge main into the epic branch
